source.quote:
Concrete new candidate: **qol = daraus?** (from that material), C0.
Keep GDT822's nine base meanings + physical fire and the two separate raiin
worlds. No then/therefore/whose/add/destination substitution for qol.

```text
qol chedy qokeey    daraus? wird? Feuer?    81r.20 / 82r.21, all three
qol chedy qokain    daraus? wird? Wasser?   75r.33, IT exact chain
daiin chedy qol    viel? wird? daraus?     77r.33, all three
```

Excerpts only, all words and syntax conjectural. This connects several local
frames without another action gloss; it does not recover a source noun.
Possible fire as source at75r.33 remains an attachment guess. No currently
named material precedes the fire frames within81r.16–31 or82r.20–33.
Water is not supplied invisibly. Most other contexts still have insufficient
meaning to decide this candidate; absence of a known contradiction is weak.

raiin stays either physical ascent or low physical heaviness, never a hybrid.

Two separate C0 meanings for exact qopchedy: **Holz? / Holzkohle?**.
Physical woody material versus charcoal, never generic fuel, drug or action.
Neither wins. Keep all GDT824 meanings and both separate raiin worlds.

81r20 admits “Holz/Holzkohle — daraus wird Feuer?” as a guessed fragment.
76r51 ZL/IT instead has `[dar] wird? Holz/Holzkohle?`: the material must also
work as a result. RF target there is opaque; f81v15 exact target only RF.
77r9 repeats the material twice in all3: not deleted or assigned two species.
No recovered source identifies wood or charcoal, and dar is still unknown.

Next: dar before becomes at76r51 and other already admitted contexts; do not
assign wood only to complete the charcoal story. Duplicate-screen first.
No material dictionary adoption. Both candidates remain exploratory C0.

Two fixed C0 dar trials: **Erde?** physical soil / **trocken?** physical low
moisture. Neither selected. Keep GDT825's separate wood/charcoal and raiin worlds.
No d/ar, darom, dardardy or other component export; no humoral dry rescue.

Important correction: dar.chedy.qopchedy76r51 does NOT require wood/charcoal
to be a result. “Trocken wird Holz?” illustrates a property-first rival with
unchanged becomes. This supersedes GDT825's mandatory-result claim, without
proving property-first syntax. ZL/IT76r9chedy.dar also permits “wird trocken?”
but has no recovered subject. Both material and property attachment remain open.

Water-dar75r32/35/76r29: physical dry fails IF directly qualifying water.
No automatic adjacent-noun rule; do not insert vanished water, residue, hidden
clauses or a humoral sense. Earth still lacks a decoded relation to water.
dar.dar75r35(all3)/36(IT_RF) stays repeated; ZL dardardy stays ONE unknown.
IT70v1Cdar versusZLzar/RFmar gives no planet or seasonal meaning.

limits: The peer lists eighteen screened reports, but this root acceptance covers only its three documented source comparisons. It is not an exhaustive claim that all propositions in eighteen reports or the full history are represented.

The GDT825 mandatory-result proposition remains a historical card; its GDT826 property-first correction already has an operative dossier. A later correction is not a reason to erase the earlier hypothesis.
No manuscript experiment, meaning confirmation, registry append or route reopening.
